text_summary: Primary navigation displaying Home, About, Courses, Events, Mentors, Contact, and Login links.
Homepage displaying eight mandatory sections in strict approved order.
Staff administration form to configure hero slides content, scheduling, and publish status.
Hero slider accessible controls supporting keyboard, swipe, indicators, and reduced motion.
About section restricted to verified institutional impact figures approved by LNA.
Learner reviews carousel displaying only approved entries with manual control and no autoplay.
Public policy pages for Privacy, Terms, and Refund Policy linked across forms and footer.
Structured administrative management forms for site content, courses, events, and reviews.
Editorial workflow enabling admins to draft, preview, publish, and archive content autonomously.
Integrity protection preventing permanent deletion of content referenced by transactions or certificates.
Audit logging capturing creator, last editor, publishing timestamp, and archiving timestamp.
Secure image upload pipeline validating format, dimensions, file size, and mandatory alternative text.
Course creation interface storing syllabus, mentors, eligibility, outcomes, FAQs, and refund terms.
Course batch scheduling managing dates, capacity, venue, pricing, and enrollment deadlines.
Course catalogue grouping batches by Open, Upcoming, and Closed without text search.
Homepage displaying open course batches, falling back to upcoming batches when none are open.
Course details page presenting batch logistics, available seats, and final payable fees upfront.
Seat reservation engine maintaining holds during checkout and preventing overselling beyond capacity.
Batch archiving preserving complete historical schedule, pricing, enrollment, and certification records.
Standard universal enrollment form across all courses without document or CV uploads.
Submission processing issuing unique reference and pending enrollment without creating auth accounts.
Duplicate prevention reconciling repeated applications for identical email and batch combinations.
Rate-limited public application status lookup requiring reference and email address.
Direct free batch confirmation bypassing payment gateway and initiating account setup.
Confirmed enrollment linking or provisioning learner profile and issuing account activation email.
Configurable dated universal and batch-specific discounts specified as percentages or fixed sums.
Discount evaluation applying batch overrides without stacking, ensuring non-negative fees.
Server-side snapshotting of base fee, applied discounts, and final payable amount.
SSLCOMMERZ hosted checkout session initiation isolated entirely on the server.
Mandatory server-to-server Order Validation and parameter matching prior to marking payment paid.
Idempotent payment notification processing preventing duplicate accounts, receipts, or seat allocations.
Payment attempt audit log retaining failed, cancelled, and expired states with retry support.
Risk-flagged transaction isolation placing questionable payments on hold pending staff review.
Automated receipt generation and activation email dispatch decoupled from payment validity.
Disabling of public user registration and social authentication in Supabase Auth.
Email and password authentication for activated learners and administrative personnel.
Session access restrictions preventing pending or disabled accounts from reaching protected portals.
Mandatory staff second-factor step-up via authenticator app or email verification code.
Single-use, rate-limited, cryptographically hashed email verification codes for staff login.
Learner profile management requiring administrative review for email and certificate name edits.
Secure self-service password reset, session expiration, and staff factor recovery workflows.
Learner dashboard presenting enrolled batches, payment status, announcements, and certificates.
Detailed course logistics displaying venue directions, schedules, announcements, and support contacts.
Self-service portal for downloading payment receipts, certificates, and tracking refund requests.
Administrative announcement broadcast publishing notices to courses/batches and emailing learners.
Announcement delivery tracking recording delivery outcomes and preventing duplicate transmissions.
Learner portal scope exclusion barring LMS elements, assignments, attendance, and video hosting.
Learner refund request submission form enforcing batch policy eligibility windows.
Administrative refund lifecycle management across Requested, Review, Approved, Rejected, Processed.
Refund processing completion requiring manual bank transfer date, amount, and reference.
Refund status tracking in learner portal coupled with automated notification emails.
Staff completion confirmation gate unlocking certificate generation for eligible learners.
Automated PDF certificate generation rendered from course-specific artwork templates.
Dynamic insertion of verified name, course, batch, date, and unique serial on certificates.
Restricted staff operations for certificate issuance, reissuance, and revocation with audit logs.
Administrative event management configuring dates, venue, capacity, covers, and registrations.
Event listing separating Upcoming and Past events while keeping past pages permanently indexable.
Free event registration enforcing capacity, preventing duplicate emails, and generating passes.
Event pass email dispatch with venue details, maintaining manual door entry procedures.
Past event archival showcase featuring short outcome summaries and optimized photo galleries.
Mentor profile administration managing biography, designation, expertise, links, and courses.
Curated testimonial publishing requiring recorded learner consent without open public submission.
Fifteen-question industry readiness assessment spanning awareness, internship, and workplace topics.
Server-side scoring algorithm calculating percentage scores from weighted 0 to 4 option choices.
Four-tier result categorization assigning Needs Improvement, Fair, Good, or Excellent labels.
Assessment completion step collecting contact info and consent, emailing results to respondent.
Assessment isolation ensuring participation has zero impact on admission or certificate rules.
Public contact page with official coordinates and rate-limited, Turnstile-protected inquiry form.
Bilingual UI toggle switching system strings between English and Bangla while content stays English.
Comprehensive operational reports covering revenue, enrollments, refunds, and events with CSV exports.
Privacy-compliant traffic analytics strictly scrubbing personal identities and payment references.
Admin portal interface providing fast search, filters, pagination, and informative empty states.
Server-side role permission checks enforcing SRS 3.2 matrix on all administrative mutations.
Administrative CSV export tools for authorized operational, financial, and event datasets.
Audit logging capturing identity and timestamp for every administrative data export operation.
Contact inquiry handling dashboard with status tracking and internal staff resolution notes.
Super Admin security console for managing staff roles, account states, and 2FA recovery.
Core Web Vitals meeting LCP <= 2.5s, INP <= 200ms, and CLS <= 0.1 on mobile.
Architecture supporting 100,000 monthly visits and 500 concurrent readers via edge caching.
Transaction write throughput tested against peak simultaneous enrollment submissions.
Public site resilience maintaining content availability during external email or analytics outages.
Server-side enforcement of account state, role permissions, and object ownership on all APIs.
Environment isolation ensuring service keys and secrets never leak to browsers or bundles.
Automated abuse protection applying distributed rate limiting and Turnstile challenges.
Session security using secure cookies, reasonable expiry, and immediate server-side revocation.
Data minimization collecting only necessary fields with explicit separation of consent types.
Compliance with WCAG 2.2 AA across keyboard access, color contrast, focus, and error messaging.
Search engine optimization via semantic markup, XML sitemaps, OpenGraph metadata, and structured data.
Cross-browser compatibility across Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox, and mobile widths from 320px.
Automated daily database backups with documented restore verification drills.
Comprehensive error logging, health checks, and alerting with strict credential and PII scrubbing.
Maintainable engineering using strict migrations, pinned packages, automated tests, and runbooks.
Learner account activation occurs only after successful payment validation or free confirmation.
SSLCOMMERZ browser redirects cannot confirm payments without independent server validation.
An applicant may enroll in multiple courses, but cannot hold duplicate confirmed seats in one batch.
Batch-specific discounts supersede universal discounts without stacking or reducing fee below zero.
Seats are officially allocated only upon payment confirmation; temporary holds expire automatically.
Closed or capacity-exhausted batches cannot initiate new payment checkout sessions.
Pending enrollment applicants do not consume authenticated user licenses or session credentials.
Applicants check application progress via public status lookup without receiving learner dashboard sessions.
Management of staff accounts, service settings, and financial corrections is restricted to Super Admin.
Editorial publishing does not require Super Admin approval, but all publish and archive events are logged.
Approved refunds transition to Processed only after manual banking transfer details are recorded.
Certificate generation requires recorded successful completion by staff and an approved template.
Certificate recipient names are derived strictly from verified legal name fields, not editable profiles.
Event registration is strictly free and does not provision learner authentication accounts.
Readiness assessment completion creates no user accounts and has no bearing on course admission.
Testimonials require documented consent and administrative authorization prior to publishing.
Editorial website copy is published in English; language toggle translates system UI strings only.
Financial, enrollment, refund, and certificate records are permanently archived rather than deleted.
End-to-end applicant enrollment and fee payment workflow for paid training batches.
Visitor registration workflow for free public workshops, masterclasses, and events.
Administrative verification and PDF generation workflow for course completion certificates.
Learner refund submission, administrative review, manual transfer, and final settlement workflow.
End-to-end verification of paid batch enrollment, seat hold, payment confirmation, and receipt delivery.
Verification of payment failure and cancellation handling, ensuring seats release and retry works.
Verification of idempotent gateway callback processing preventing duplicate receipts or records.
Concurrency load verification proving batch seat capacity is strictly enforced under parallel checkout.
Verification of free batch enrollment confirming instant seat reservation and account activation.
Verification of rate-limited application status lookup requiring reference and email address.
Authorization test proving learners cannot access another learner profile, receipt, or certificate.
Verification of staff authentication, 2FA step-up enforcement, and role permission boundaries.
Verification of refund request submission, staff review, manual payment recording, and status email.
Verification of completion certificate generation from template and tamper-evident download.
Verification of event registration duplicate checks, capacity caps, and digital pass emailing.
Verification of 15-question readiness scoring algorithm, result categorization, and email dispatch.
Verification of content draft, preview, publish, and archive lifecycles without deployments.
Verification of analytics data privacy confirming complete absence of PII in telemetry payloads.
Automated WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit verifying keyboard navigation, contrast, and focus states.
